entities.summary: Mahmud, a notable figure in the history of Afghanistan, associated with Ghaznavid and Ghurid Empires (977–1186). Their legacy influenced Mahmud of Ghazni raids the Somnath temple, one of seventeen campaigns into India and Al-Biruni writes Kitab al-Hind, a systematic study of Indian civilization.
